text:
Priya Nair: proposing cut window for next release — Wed Apr 8 at 11:00 PT. aiming for a single cut (no staged). can everyone confirm availability? :calendar:
Mike Chen: 11:00 PT works for eng but would prefer 10:30 if possible (doubles as our usual triage). :clock1030:
Jenna Ortiz: I have a customer call at 11, 10:30 is better for me too.
Caroline Wu: 10:30 is fine. also please add a short design review slot for the telemetry change (5–10m).
Alice Park: +1 for 10:30. I'll be the SRE on-call for the cut.
Priya Nair: ok locking 10:30 PT then. agenda draft below, please thumbs-up or suggest edits.
Priya Nair: ```Agenda (30m):
1) Roll call & rollback owner assignment (5m)
2) Smoke tests & canary plan (10m)
3) Telemetry/design review (5m)
4) Cut + verification checklist (8m)
```
Ben S.: pinging @Alice Park for rollback owner, @Caroline Wu to confirm canary hosts.
Alice Park: I can be rollback owner. will stay on channel during cut. :white_check_mark:
Caroline Wu: canary hosts are us-east-1-gpu-a and -b; plan is 5% traffic for 15m then ramp if green. I'll paste the quick steps in the thread shortly.
Mike Chen: small ask — can we do the DB migration first in read-replica mode and keep the old code fallback for 10m? reduces risk.
Priya Nair: good call. add to checklist: "migrate replicas, sanity queries, promote if ok".
ReleaseBot: reminder: cut checklist template attached — https://redwood.internal/releases/checklists/template-v2 (auto-post)
Jenna Ortiz: also need a quick PR review window: @Ben S. can you approve #4821 by EOD Mon? it's the only blocker.
Ben S.: yeah I'll review today. if anything, I'll request a small follow-up fix, but should be quick.
Caroline Wu: canary steps (quick):
```
- deploy model-service:v2 to canary hosts (us-east-1-gpu-a,b)
- run smoke-suite.sh against canaries
- monitor latency and errors for 15m (SLOs: p99 < 250ms, error < 0.5%)
- if green, roll 20% for 10m, then 100% after final check
```
Priya Nair: outstanding asks before Wed 10:30 PT:
- @Ben S. PR #4821 review (EOD Mon)
- @Caroline Wu confirm canary hosts & perf run (today)
- @Mike Chen validate migration plan + rollback scripts (tomorrow)
- All: RSVP if you cannot attend the 10:30 cut window

Alice Park: RSVP: attending, on-call.
Mike Chen: attending, will run migration test tomorrow morning.
Jenna Ortiz: attending but will join 2m late due to call wrap.
Ben S.: attending, will have PR done.
Caroline Wu: attending and will start perf run now.
Priya Nair: thanks — I'll publish the final agenda and invite for 10:30 PT Wed Apr 8. I'll also pin the checklist in the channel. :pushpin: :rocket:
ReleaseBot: noted. automated guardrails will run pre-cut — I'll post the preflight results 30m before the cut.
Mike Chen: small note — please include the rollback command in the agenda so it's easy to copy during the cut: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/model-service -n prod`.
Priya Nair: added. final check: any blockers we missed?
Ben S.: none from infra.
Jenna Ortiz: none from product.
Caroline Wu: perf run green so far. :eyes:
Priya Nair: great — locking 10:30 PT Wed Apr 8. I'll send calendar invite; if anything changes, flag here. :thumbsup:
